verdict.rationale: Factory documents inline, line-by-line code review comments on a diff (factory-docs-14, factory-docs-19) and 'put code review on autopilot across your repos,' suggesting automated review capability, but there is no explicit evidence of a PR-triggered automatic review workflow (e.g., GitHub PR webhook integration, automatic invocation on PR open) — the review appears tied to manually invoked Droid sessions rather than an automatic PR gate. missing for 10: explicit PR-trigger/webhook automation, evidence of it running as a required CI check or GitHub App review bot, independent/hands-on confirmation of automatic PR reviews.
